zh.title: 中華航空連續四年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎 組織團隊指標獲最高分
zh.summary: 中華航空連續4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎；組織團隊指標奪最高分
body: 中華航空於2026年8月17日發布新聞稿表示，該公司連續第4年獲得「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」。在本次評選中，中華航空於「組織團隊」指標表現尤為亮眼，並獲得該項指標最高分數，展現員工對團隊合作與職場環境的高度認同。
「亞洲最佳企業雇主獎」為人力資源領域評選，今年台灣區共有330家企業參選。華航指出，公司視員工為重要資產，除提供具市場競爭力的薪資、優待機票及員工持股信託等福利外，亦推動工作生活平衡活動與人才培育計畫，建立共融職場文化。

en.title: China Airlines Wins Best Companies to Work for in Asia Award for Fourth Consecutive Year
en.summary: China Airlines won the Best Companies to Work for in Asia award for the fourth consecutive year.
body: China Airlines announced on August 17, 2026, that it has been awarded the Best Companies to Work for in Asia award for the fourth consecutive year. In the latest evaluation, the carrier scored highest in the team dynamics metric, reflecting strong employee identification with team collaboration and the organizational environment.

A total of 330 companies in Taiwan participated in this year's award selection. China Airlines stated that it regards employees as essential assets, offering competitive salaries, discounted ticket privileges, and employee stock ownership trusts, while promoting work-life balance initiatives and talent development programs to foster an inclusive workplace culture.
